---
title: "03 — Q2: reference database and simplification"
author: "Adrien Taudière"
---

Effect of the reference database and of its simplification (`config.R`:
the whole release, its Fungi-only records, and Fungi plus non-fungal
representatives `_Fungi_rep`; the primer-trimmed `_Fungi_cut` belongs to the
final zoom only). Figures: Q2.1 (per-DB accuracy), Q2.2 (paired
simplification effect), Q2.5 (DB size vs compute cost and accuracy).

Every section has one tab per mock and ITSx region (`analysis_views()` in
`00_setup.R`), on the ASVs: Pauvert ITS1, then Tedersoo ITS1, ITS2 and full.
The figures are saved once per view, suffixed with it. The costs of Q2.5 come
from each dataset's own assignment store (`costs_for()`).

```{r setup}
here::i_am("analysis/03_q2_databases.qmd")  # _quarto.yml would otherwise make here() root = analysis/
source(here::here("analysis/00_setup.R"))
res_all <- cache_read("res_comp_tax")
views <- analysis_views(res_all)

# Default settings (bootstrap 0.5 / rel_majority), with the simplification
# step of each database.
q2_base <- function(res) {
  res |>
    filter(metrics %in% c("F1_score", "MCC")) |>
    filter_default_settings() |>
    left_join(db_meta, by = "db") |>
    mutate(
      tax_level      = factor(tax_level,      levels = tax_order),
      simplification = factor(simplification, levels = unique(db_meta$simplification))
    )
}
```

## Summary

```{r summary-data}
#| include: false
# Computed from the same views and filters as the tabs below.
s03_genus <- view_rows(res_all, views) |>
  filter(metrics == "F1_score", tax_level == "Genus") |>
  filter_default_settings() |>
  left_join(db_meta, by = "db")
s03_by_db <- s03_genus |>
  group_by(view, db, db_base, simplification) |>
  summarise(value = mean(values), .groups = "drop")
s03_spread_db <- s03_by_db |>
  group_by(view) |>
  summarise(spread = max(value) - min(value), .groups = "drop")
s03_spread_algo <- s03_genus |>
  group_by(view, algo) |>
  summarise(value = mean(values), .groups = "drop") |>
  group_by(view) |>
  summarise(spread = max(value) - min(value), .groups = "drop")
s03_by_source <- s03_by_db |>
  group_by(view, db_base) |>
  summarise(value = mean(value), .groups = "drop") |>
  rename(source = db_base)
# Paired steps within a source, per method: full -> Fungi, Fungi -> Fungi+rep.
s03_steps <- s03_genus |>
  select(view, algo, db_base, simplification, values) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = simplification, values_from = values) |>
  transmute(
    view, algo, db_base,
    `full → Fungi` = Fungi - full,
    `Fungi → Fungi+rep` = `Fungi+rep` - Fungi
  ) |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(c(`full → Fungi`, `Fungi → Fungi+rep`), names_to = "step", values_to = "delta")
s03_step_mean <- s03_steps |>
  group_by(view, step) |>
  summarise(delta = mean(delta), .groups = "drop")
s03_db_word <- if (all(s03_spread_db$spread < s03_spread_algo$spread)) {
  "smaller than the spread between methods in every view (Q1)"
} else {
  "not always smaller than the spread between methods (Q1)"
}
```

Default settings, ASVs, Genus F1 averaged over the four methods; one value
per view.

- **Best database**: `r best_phrase(s03_by_db, "db")`. Best minus worst
  database `r fmt_range(s03_spread_db$spread)` per view, `r s03_db_word`
  (`r fmt_range(s03_spread_algo$spread)`).
- **Best source** (mean of its three variants): `r best_phrase(s03_by_source, "source")`.
- **Simplification**, paired within a source, mean over sources and methods:
  full → Fungi `r fmt_range(s03_step_mean$delta[s03_step_mean$step == "full → Fungi"])`,
  Fungi → Fungi+rep `r fmt_range(s03_step_mean$delta[s03_step_mean$step == "Fungi → Fungi+rep"])`
  across the views.

```{r summary-fig-db}
#| echo: false
fig_summary_03_genus_by_db <- s03_genus |>
  ggplot(aes(x = values, y = db, colour = algo)) +
  geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_point(
    data = s03_by_db, aes(x = value, y = db), inherit.aes = FALSE,
    shape = 124, size = 6
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~view, nrow = 1) +
  labs(x = "Genus F1 (dots: methods; bar: their mean)", y = NULL, colour = "Method") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
print(fig_summary_03_genus_by_db)
save_fig(fig_summary_03_genus_by_db, "fig_summary_03_genus_by_db", width = 16, height = 5)
```

```{r summary-fig-steps}
#| echo: false
fig_summary_03_simplification <- s03_steps |>
  ggplot(aes(x = algo, y = delta, colour = db_base)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_point(size = 2, position = position_dodge(width = 0.5)) +
  facet_grid(step ~ view) +
  labs(x = "Method", y = "Δ Genus F1 (simplified − previous)", colour = "Source") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
print(fig_summary_03_simplification)
save_fig(fig_summary_03_simplification, "fig_summary_03_simplification", width = 16, height = 6)
```

## Q2.1 — Per-DB accuracy

Default settings (bootstrap 0.5 / rel_majority). `db_meta` (which
simplification step each DB represents) comes from `config.R`.

```{r q2-1, results = "asis"}
view_tabs(res_all, views, function(res, v) {
  fig_q2_db <- q2_base(res) |>
    ggplot(aes(x = db, y = values, fill = simplification)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_dodge()) +
    facet_grid(metrics + algo ~ tax_level) +
    labs(x = "Database", y = "Value", fill = "Simplification") +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 55, hjust = 1))
  print(fig_q2_db)
  save_fig(fig_q2_db, paste0("fig_q2_db_", v$id), width = 18, height = 14)
})
```

## Q2.2 — Simplification effect (paired Δ F1/MCC)

Paired comparisons within each source release: full → Fungi and
Fungi → Fungi+rep, derived from `db_meta` in `config.R`, so they follow the
databases actually benchmarked.

```{r q2-2, results = "asis"}
# Signed delta (simplified − full) for one pair of databases.
db_pair_delta <- function(data, db_full, db_simp, label) {
  data |>
    filter(db %in% c(db_full, db_simp)) |>
    select(algo, tax_level, metrics, db, values) |>
    pivot_wider(names_from = db, values_from = values) |>
    mutate(
      delta      = .data[[db_simp]] - .data[[db_full]],
      comparison = label
    ) |>
    select(algo, tax_level, metrics, comparison, delta)
}

# Pairs (from -> to) of simplification steps within the same source.
pair_steps <- function(from, to) {
  inner_join(
    filter(db_meta, simplification == from),
    filter(db_meta, simplification == to),
    by = "db_base",
    suffix = c("_full", "_simp")
  ) |>
    transmute(db_full, db_simp, label = paste0(db_base, ": ", from, " → ", to))
}

db_pairs <- bind_rows(pair_steps("full", "Fungi"), pair_steps("Fungi", "Fungi+rep"))

view_tabs(res_all, views, function(res, v) {
  base <- q2_base(res)
  tab_q2_simplif <- purrr::pmap(
    db_pairs,
    \(db_full, db_simp, label) db_pair_delta(base, db_full, db_simp, label)
  ) |>
    bind_rows() |>
    mutate(tax_level = factor(tax_level, levels = tax_order))

  tab_q2_simplif |>
    group_by(comparison, algo, metrics, tax_level) |>
    summarise(delta_mean = round(mean(delta, na.rm = TRUE), 3), .groups = "drop") |>
    pivot_wider(names_from = tax_level, values_from = delta_mean) |>
    arrange(comparison, metrics, algo) |>
    cat_kable(caption = "Δ F1/MCC (simplified − full). Positive = simplification helps.")

  fig_q2_simplif <- tab_q2_simplif |>
    ggplot(aes(x = algo, y = delta, fill = comparison)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.4, linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_dodge()) +
    facet_grid(metrics ~ tax_level) +
    labs(x = "Method", y = "Δ (simplified − full)", fill = "Comparison") +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
  print(fig_q2_simplif)
  save_fig(fig_q2_simplif, paste0("fig_q2_simplification_", v$id), width = 18, height = 8)
})
```

## Q2.5 — DB size vs compute cost and accuracy

Does a smaller (filtered / trimmed) DB pay for itself in runtime without
losing F1? Uses `benchmark_costs` (see `05_m2_costs.qmd` for its provenance),
restricted to the computations of the view's region.

```{r q2-5, results = "asis"}
view_tabs(res_all, views, function(res, v) {
  db_size_tbl <- costs_for(v$dataset, res) |>
    filter(phase %in% res$method_db, !startsWith(db, "mini_")) |>
    mutate(db_size_mb = file.size(here(db_path)) / 1e6) |>
    group_by(db, db_size_mb) |>
    summarise(mean_wall_h = mean(wall_time_s, na.rm = TRUE) / 3600,
              .groups = "drop")

  f1_by_db <- res |>
    filter(metrics == "F1_score", tax_level == "Gen_sp") |>
    filter_default_settings() |>
    group_by(db) |>
    summarise(mean_f1 = mean(values, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

  q2_5_data <- left_join(db_size_tbl, f1_by_db, by = "db") |>
    left_join(db_meta |> select(db, db_base, simplification), by = "db")

  p_size_time <- q2_5_data |>
    ggplot(aes(x = db_size_mb, y = mean_wall_h, color = db_base, label = simplification)) +
    geom_point(size = 3) +
    ggrepel::geom_label_repel(size = 2.5, show.legend = FALSE) +
    labs(x = "DB size (MB)", y = "Mean wall time (h)", color = "DB family") +
    theme_bw()

  p_size_f1 <- q2_5_data |>
    ggplot(aes(x = db_size_mb, y = mean_f1, color = db_base, label = simplification)) +
    geom_point(size = 3) +
    ggrepel::geom_label_repel(size = 2.5, show.legend = FALSE) +
    labs(x = "DB size (MB)", y = "Mean F1 (Gen_sp)", color = "DB family") +
    theme_bw()

  fig_q2_5 <- p_size_time / p_size_f1 + patchwork::plot_layout(guides = "collect")
  print(fig_q2_5)
  save_fig(fig_q2_5, paste0("fig_q2_5_size_cost_", v$id), width = 8, height = 10)
})
```
